summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I did before writing this:** read the actual watchlist path end-to-end (not just the ticket's hypothesis) — `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, and `server.ts`. No code was changed.  **What I found (verified, not guessed):** - Watchlist tables are correctly scoped by `user_id`; every handler (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, add/remove item) filters or inserts against `watchlists.user_id`. - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/ano
